sense.text:
“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms”. That is what the prophets do: they prophesy against countries and great kingdoms. So you will hear the word spoken against America, against Europe, against China, against Russia, because the prophets prophesy against great kingdoms.

They prophesied “of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” Some say, every week it is death and destruction and war, I want a good life, I want the love of Jesus. But the prophets prophesied of war, and war is coming on this earth. It is the job of the leaders to prepare your mind and let you know what is coming.

The evil that is coming includes a global economic collapse: the money in your bank account will disappear. And the pestilence is the diseases and plagues that are going to hit this earth. When it comes to pass, you will know that a prophet was among you.

“I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.” When affliction starts, that is when people seek God. Right now many are comfortable, but affliction is coming.

That affliction is not only oppression by the white man. It is the famine coming: a global economic collapse, brothers and sisters losing their jobs, a great depression. The Lord is allowing it to happen because he wants his people to seek him. When things get bad, he wants you to seek him.

precepts.why:
The other thing God wants in that affliction: “Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired”. Many are independent and selfish and care only about self. You have a good job now; but when things collapse and you lose that job, you will have to rely on the brother or sister next to you.

So the Lord is going to force us to gather together and work together: start farms together, start community together. The house with the white picket fence where you don’t want to be around anybody is what America taught you. This is about us working together and preparing to survive what is coming.

sense.text:
Trusting in uncertain riches. “Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal”. You lay up treasure on the earth when you have millions sitting in the bank when that money could be given to the poor, and giving to the poor means bringing it to the leaders to distribute as needed in the congregation, not handing millions to a crackhead on the street.

Everything laid up upon this earth you could lose. In the collapse of 2008 people could not withdraw their money: the banks said they only insure you up to $100,000, so where is the rest? They stole it. That is the bank, where thieves break through and steal. The bank takes your money and loans it to investors; when Wall Street and the investors go belly up, your money is gone too. The whole American system is built on debt and credit, and our people live beyond their means on credit cards. What is hard to obtain is harder to maintain. We must learn to live below our means, because the comfort of Babylon, the food stamps and social security and everything set up to make you comfortable, will be lost.

“But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal”. You lay up treasure in heaven by helping the saints, by good works, by helping your brothers and sisters financially in this truth. Even the poor one who can give only $5 a week is storing up riches in heaven.

“For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.” Ask yourself what your treasure is. Is it the truth, or the house, the car, the Lamborghini, the $10 million in the bank? It is nice to have a nice house, but it should not be a treasure; you must be willing to lose it, and you cannot love it more than God. If your treasure is this world and your job, that is where your mind is occupied; if your treasure is the kingdom of heaven, you will be occupying yourself in that.

“The light of the body is the eye”. Whatever your eyes see, that is what you desire, and your body follows it. “If therefore thine eye be single”, focused on one thing, “thy whole body shall be full of light”: focused on the truth, the word of God, the kingdom of God.

“But if thine eye be evil”: your mind is only on money, on the treasures of this world, getting rich and being flamboyant. Then “thy whole body shall be full of darkness.” “How great is that darkness!” That covetousness, that love of this world, how great it is.

“No man can serve two masters”. You cannot serve Christ and Satan; you have to make a choice. This world belongs to Satan and we are only passing through; the jobs and money we have are to navigate through it, a roof over our heads and what is necessary. Some the Most High blesses with more because money will not defile them. But you cannot be chasing money with three, four jobs and trying to serve God.

“For either he will hate the one, and love the other”. Many brothers end up hating the Lord, because the Lord gives restrictions while Satan says you can live it up, there are no rules. Then you see that brother less and less: he is always working, he has a bigger house to pay for.

Satan comes through a person and offers a job at $150,000, half a million, a million a year, if you will only work on the Sabbath. Saying no is easy while you sit here; when the temptation comes, that is the real test. Those who say God will understand, I am in captivity, were tested and failed. Daniel in captivity asked for the Sabbath off and would not eat unclean food, and our forefathers in the time of the Maccabees would rather die than break the Sabbath. The Sabbath is not only resting your body: it represents righteousness, paradise, where we were in the beginning, the kingdom of God when we are at rest from these nations ruling over us. Don’t ask the leaders if it is okay; the answer is no. And the one who says he will take the Sabbath job and give half to the truth ends up working all the damn time and nobody sees him anymore. That is how Satan sets you up.

“Ye cannot serve God and mammon.” Mammon is money. You cannot serve money.

“Take no thought for your life”: this is the state of mind the followers of Christ must have. Many think they can direct their life: by this age I will accomplish this, have my house, have five kids. Stop taking thought for your life, what you will do tomorrow.

“Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?” People died last night, people are sick and dying of diseases, and you are here worrying about a damn light bill, a car note, a mortgage, the rent, what you will eat next week. Often only when something bad happens, when sickness comes, do you realize your health and your body are worth more than all of that.

“Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?” The Lord knows what you need and he will help you: he will allow opportunities to come along. But you have to believe that.

“And why take ye thought for raiment?” To take thought is to worry. Why worry about clothes? The lilies of the field toil not, and “even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.” If God clothes the grass of the field, “shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?”

Little faith is the key. The one who keeps worrying about bills, the sister stressing her husband out, worries because of little faith. You serve the creator of the heaven and the earth and you worry about minor things. Have faith that the Lord has you: he blesses in different ways, through the people around you, through jobs he sends, even a job from a white man.

“Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?” “For after all these things do the Gentiles seek”. White people worry about these things, and because we have been enslaved among them they taught us to worry about them: go to college, finish this, by forty start having children. The Gentiles, the other nations, care about these things; we shouldn’t. “Your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.”

“But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness”, and his righteousness is keeping the commandments. Many end up in bad situations because they do not seek God first: four, five, six jobs, no prayer, not coming around to learn. Some are going through hard times right now because they don’t put God first, and the Lord makes it hard until they learn to seek him first.

You must seek first the kingdom of God, to hell with your damn job. But that does not mean quit your job on Monday and then ask the deacon to pay your rent. It is a balanced state. Put God first, and “all these things shall be added unto you”: food, clothing, shelter, what you need to take care of yourself and your family in this wicked world. These things are not bad; the Lord gives them when you seek him first.

“Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself.” Stop worrying about tomorrow, the bill that will be disconnected. When something is out of your hands and there is nothing you can do, stop worrying and ask the Lord for help.

“Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.” Every day something bad happens; that is life. The evil of each day is enough for itself.

precepts.why:
This is how you lay up treasure in heaven. One came saying “Good Master, what good thing shall I do”, and Christ answered, “if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments”, and named them: “Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.”

The young man said he had kept these from his youth: “what lack I yet?” “If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor”. That is not saying give away everything you have: this man had excess, he had a lot, so sell and help the poor. Giving to the poor means giving to the poor believers, to the leaders, who distribute to those among us who need it, as in Acts.

“And thou shalt have treasure in heaven.” So when Christ said store up your riches in heaven, he was speaking of giving, of good works. When you take the money you have on the earth and help the righteous and help this truth, you are storing up riches in heaven.

The Gentiles worry about these things, but we are not to. “Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world.” The things of this world must not be put above God. “If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him”: if you love this society, this kingdom, God’s spirit is not in you.

“For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh”: the desires everybody has in their flesh, sexual, power, many lusts. “And the lust of the eyes”: what you see and lust after, money or women. “And the pride of life”: the big house to show off to your family and the people you went to school with, look what I accomplished.

It “is not of the Father, but is of the world.” So sisters, stop stressing your husbands out trying to keep up with the Joneses because of the pride of life. Soon none of it is going to matter.

sense.text:
“Take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting”. Surfeiting means overindulgence, excess: excess work, excess drinking. “And drunkenness, and cares of this life”: always working, worrying about bills and your house.

Corporate calls from Walmart and says we will make you manager, an extra $3,000, make it $6,000 a year, but you must stay late and carry more responsibility. You think God just blessed you. But now you spend less time with your family, less time at the school, less time studying. That is not God blessing you; that is Satan trying to take you out. Some get curses and think they are blessings.

“And so that day come upon you unawares”: the day of the Lord sneaks up on you and you don’t see it, because you are caught up in this world and can’t serve God.

“For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.” The day of the Lord is going to come as a trap. But if we watch, if we stay focused, it will not come as a trap: “Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.”

One asked Christ to make his brother divide the inheritance with him. “Who made me a judge or a divider over you?” Then: “Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.”

Our people think that because they have the nice house and the nice car, the pride of life read in 1 John, their life is worth their possessions. The worth of a man’s life is not the money, land, cars and houses, or what is in his bank account.

“The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully”: he had land that brought forth a lot of crops, and no room to bestow them. So: “I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.”

“Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” In his mind: I have enough stored up for years, I worked hard, now I can relax and enjoy life. That is laying up treasure upon the earth, which Matthew 6 said not to do.

“Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee”. He is talking about tearing down barns next week, and he is about to die tonight, of a heart attack or whatever it is. That is why life is more than meat. This man trusted in his riches. Always put your trust in God and not in riches.

This is war. Some brothers and sisters are sown among thorns: the word springs up, but the thorns choke it. “He that heareth the word” is the one who came into the truth and is among us now, but has “the care of this world”: wanting the nice house, the nice things, the nice cars. Nothing is wrong with wanting these things; something is wrong when you put them before God.

It is called “the deceitfulness of riches” because to get you rich Satan comes at you with deceit, all to destroy you, choke you and pull you out of this truth. It comes through a promotion on your job and many other ways. A brother wanted to become a millionaire and left. Some want to scam; some used to do crimes, can’t do them among us, don’t want a regular 9 to 5, and leave.

This is how the choking happens: you take a job on the Sabbath, you show up less, there is no growth in your spirit, and eventually you fall off. The riches choke the word in you, “and he becometh unfruitful”: Satan takes you out, you go back into the world, you lost the battle. Many ask why they left. You left because you could not endure, because you were not one of the elect.

“When thou hast enough, remember the time of hunger”. When the Lord blesses you with enough, a good job, a nice savings, remember when you had nothing. Some grew up poor, got a little something, and forgot where they came from. Those who had nothing appreciate what they get; those who were given everything never knew want and don’t appreciate it. So we must learn to live below our means and within our means.

“And when thou art rich, think upon poverty and need.” Why think on poverty when you are rich? Because you could lose everything, and some will. Christ said we must be willing to lose everything for the kingdom and his name’s sake.

A financial collapse is about to take place, and it is engineered by the high-ups in society; Trump is not that stupid. It is being forced to bring in the one world order and one digital currency, because the US dollar is losing its power and dominance and they must replace it. The money in your bank account is not even real riches. It is fiat money: by decree, worth what the government says, backed by no gold or silver, enforced by force. It has been so since after World War II, first on the gold standard and then fiat.

The Great Depression of 1929, with the banks collapsed and a quarter unemployed, will happen again on a much higher level, and because every nation is pegged to the US dollar, when it falls every economy falls. The 40-hour week was set up in the 1920s for control: they say they pay you for your time, but your time is your life, your life force, and we have become wage slaves, a new sharecropping, with every check going right back into bills by design. The 401k, the IRA, retirement funds, stocks and paper gold were set up to feed Wall Street, a Ponzi scheme; when it goes belly up those will be gone. Even the paper gold the banks sell you online is not real: the same gold is sold to millions, a Ponzi scheme, and China has shut that trading down so that only physical gold can be bought. There is nothing wrong with buying a little real gold and putting it to the side instead of leaving all your money in the bank, but don’t let anybody know, or you will get robbed.

That is why the scripture says when you are rich, think upon poverty: things can get bad at any time, and they will.

A man is asked, ten trillion dollars or ten minutes with Jesus, and says give me the ten trillion, I’ll give Jesus 10%. These Christians are stupid; that is a covetous man. Our people do a lot of things for money.

“Why is earth and ashes proud? There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man: for such an one setteth his own soul to sale”. The covetous man sells his soul, and that is what our people have done in the Christian church.

“Because while he liveth he casteth away his bowels.” He gives up his booty hole. That is what it means: if you are covetous you will sell your booty hole. You get diddified; you become a Diddyite.

This is prophecy concerning America. “Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” Why would the heathen greatly despise America and Israel? Not only for the war in Palestine. America and Israel will do things that collapse the world economy.

What they did to Iran is affecting the whole world: the Strait of Hormuz closed, Trump trying to make a deal because Iran and the Houthi rebels are hitting the world economy, US debt near $40 trillion, Japan, the largest foreign holder of US debt, ready to dump American bonds. The war America and Israel made with Iran is going to cause a worldwide economic collapse and famine all over the world, not only in third world countries but in Europe also.

The whole world economic system since 1945 is set up around the US dollar: America became the military and economic superpower, created the IMF, the SWIFT system and the World Bank, and controls world finance, telling nations what their money is worth next to the dollar, to rob Africa and the third world. That bubble is bursting. What Trump is doing is what the Lord prophesied he would do, and that is why the world will hate America. Order out of chaos: those above Trump want to get rid of paper money so that everything you buy they can see, and when they deem us a hate group they can turn our money off.

What should we do? Is the deacon just making everybody paranoid? “And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times”. Sisters look for a man with a stable job, but when things get bad there will be no stability in a job. The stability will be wisdom and knowledge: the leaders and teachers tell you what is going to happen and how to prepare for it. Getting a 9 to 5 will not help you; the wisdom and knowledge the leaders teach is your stability. Apply it.

We must think differently: work together, buy land, build a community, separate ourselves as God said. If the system collapses, we are not part of their system; we should be laughing, not crying, because the bishops and deacons already told us to be prepared. The financial collapse will bring a societal nightmare, because our people got comfortable and forgot about farming and surviving; if the lights go off, some will die. When it comes, the banks will be closed, the ATMs will not work, and in three days the stores will be emptied. Prepare weeks and months of food in your house so you are not running to the store when it happens, and don’t run for toilet paper: can you eat toilet paper? The sewage system is going to shut down, and you will have to dig a hole in your backyard. the pantries are mainly for the old and the young, because the young, the elderly and the fatherless come first.

“And strength of salvation”: that is how you will be saved from the economic collapse and what comes on this earth. “The fear of the Lord is his treasure”: that is where treasure is.
“Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without”: they will cry because they have no food, nothing, no ways or means to take care of themselves.

Tyrus was spoken of back then, but it is twofold and speaks of America also. “Say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord God; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God”. That is the white man and America today: they think they are God. Someone will rise up here in America and set himself up as Christ, a Christianity 2.0, as Antiochus set himself up as God in Daniel 8; that is why Christ said if they say he is in the wilderness, believe it not. There will be fake miracles through technology, and some will believe it.

“I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas”, in the midst of all the nations. “Yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God”: you ain’t no damn God. The so-called white man sets his heart as the heart of God.

“Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel”: through his technology. People in other countries can see and hear this class as it is spoken. In the old days that was called magic; today it is called technology, but it is witchcraft, and when Christ returns all of it must go. “There is no secret that they can hide from thee”: he can turn on your device and watch you. Brothers watching porn, the white man sees what you are watching on your Google account. The Lord sees you, the devil sees you, and the white man sees you too.

“With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures”. America got rich not through resources and gold but by making all nations peg their money to the American dollar, the world standard for trade. That was their wisdom. Then they set up the IMF and the World Bank to keep the dark nations in check, rob and steal from them, and dictate what their money is worth. That is their witchcraft: to say my money is backed by my economy and not gold, my paper is the top money and everybody must use it. That is fiat money, done in 1971.

“By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches”: through the IMF, through trade, through technology, and as the number one weapons seller on the earth.

But America used its dollar to sanction nations, Russia, China, Iran, so the nations stopped wanting the dollar and it has been declining for years; the tariffs on all nations and the Iran war speed it up. BRICS is a threat to the dollar, and America will collapse the whole world system to destroy BRICS, and the nations will be angry with America for doing it for her own interests.

“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich”. The merchants are the corporations. They are rich “through the abundance of her delicacies.” China and all nations got rich by trading with America, except Africa: they kept us poor over there.

“For in one hour so great riches is come to nought.” America is the richest country on the earth, and in one hour all the riches here are going to come to nought. In the global collapse America will come out on top while Europe and the other countries feel it, and that is why they will destroy this place. The crypto that many made money off of was set up by the CIA; America has been planning this for a while.

“And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond”: small nations and great nations, and also people, rich or poor. Before, only nations were sanctioned, Cuba and Russia; now they sanction individuals, so the system is evolving from the international level to the personal level. “Free and bond”: whether in prison or free, and it goes into nations too: Africa is a bond country, under Europe and America.

“To receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads”. That mark is the same mark Cain had in the beginning, the mark of sin; God destroyed everybody back then, and Cain’s descendants came back as Esau with the same mark on them today. The right hand is what you support; the forehead is what you believe. They may be trying to put chips in people, but the mark the Bible speaks of is sin: following this man’s lies and religions, democracy, Christianity, his policies and politics, everything the white man pushes. Don’t take part in any of his ways.

“And that no man might buy or sell”. This is where we are coming when they destroy the paper money system and bring in the digital system they have planned for years. The mark of the beast is already here, but the buying and selling on a personal level will be enforced: you will not be able to take $2 or $5 to the store. Fed Now is being rolled out with the digital currency, so the government will know everything you buy. It is about control. That is why you no longer pick up a paycheck; it goes straight to your bank account. Money will be digital and programmable, and they can stop you individually from buying and selling, food included, by shutting down your bank account and your whole digital footprint, your YouTube and Facebook pages, because they don’t want this gospel taught. They will start with the leaders, calling us a hate group, and the people will have to buy food for the leaders.

“Save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.” Support this system and you can buy and sell; go against it and teach against it, as God commands the leaders to do, and they will cut you off. For that to happen they must get rid of paper money, and that is what the global economic collapse will be used for. Prepare for what is coming.
